testcase.name: a nonsense density or scale still produces readable text()
a drag moves the chart with the finger at any zoom()
the crosshair reads the price at the pointer, the right way up()
zoom is bounded and reversible about the latest bar()
a short series is shown whole rather than padded()
a pan with no plot to pan over is a no-op()
dragging the other way walks forward in time and stops at the latest bar()
the window cannot be dragged off either end()
the crosshair snaps to a bar the series actually has()
the scale is banded so the labels do not eat the candles()
a nonsense zoom factor changes nothing()
chart text follows the owner's font scale()
the default window shows the most recent bars()
a pointer outside the plot has nothing under it()
an empty series produces an empty window instead of a crash()
